mean = jnp.array([0., 0.])
key =   random.PRNGKey(666)
covariance = jnp.array([[1., .3], [.3, 1.]])
X = random.multivariate_normal(
    key,
    mean, 
    covariance,
    100
)
plt.grid(alpha=0.5)
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], facecolor="none", edgecolors="red", s=60)
plt.show()
